info.title: Manual insurer remittance advice (P4-M5-A)
info.description: Manual, immutable insurer advice observations. Reported amounts do not represent verified cash or trigger financial posting.

get.description: Requires insurance_remittances.view, patients.view, and active tenant membership. Returns paginated immutable advice metadata with private/no-store caching.

200.description: Paginated advice in the standard API envelope.

403.description: Missing exact permission or active tenant access.

422.description: Invalid date filter or pagination input.

post.description: Requires insurance_remittances.record and patients.view. Staff observation only; does not create a payment, allocation, receivable, or balance change. Retries with the same idempotency key and payload return the original record.

source_provenance.example: Staff transcribed the paper advice received by clinic mail.

201.description: Advice and immutable lines recorded; standard API envelope.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an identical recording.

403.description: Missing exact permission or patient/evidence access.

404.description: Insurer or referenced tenant/patient record not found.

409.description: Duplicate insurer reference or idempotency key conflict.

422.description: Invalid observation or inconsistent patient, claim, submission, currency, or evidence lineage.

get.description: Requires insurance_remittances.view and patients.view. Returns staff-entered advice observation, not an insurer-verified fact.

200.description: Advice in the standard API envelope.

403.description: Missing exact permission or active tenant access.

404.description: Advice is outside the active tenant.

get.description: Requires insurance_remittances.view and patients.view. Returns paginated immutable reported line values; unknown amounts remain null.

200.description: Paginated lines in the standard API envelope.

403.description: Missing exact permission or active tenant access.

404.description: Advice is outside the active tenant.

post.description: Requires insurance_remittances.correct and patients.view. Creates a new immutable advice with explicit correction_reason; the original is preserved. The correction retains insurer and currency.

correction_reason.example: Corrected amount transcribed from the replacement advice.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an identical correction.

403.description: Missing exact permission or patient/evidence access.

404.description: Advice or referenced record not found in active tenant.

409.description: Advice already corrected or idempotency conflict.

TenantHeader.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantHeader.description: Optional tenant selector. Must identify an active tenant membership; never authorizes cross-tenant access.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique UUID for an idempotent create/correction command.
